In this paper, we confirm this by showing that the Hu-Li-Yang conjecture holds when n≥42.5​k+48n\geq 42.5k+48. We disprove the conjecture of Wu et al. and propose a modified conjecture.
This conjecture is motivated by previous works due to Allen, Böttcher, Hladký, and Piguet on Turán number of vertex-disjoint triangles.
  




1 Introduction
